auth.model: guest booking by durable reference using the backend SDK persistence layer
rules: a guest can recover a booking by opening its exact durable reference route
a guest who does not have a valid reference sees 'Booking not found'
the booking flow does not require sign-up or sign-in

routes.name: Home
routes.purpose: Editorial landing page for Ember Table with supper club story, dining format, fixed service information, and entry point to booking

routes.name: Booking Wizard
routes.purpose: Multi-step booking flow for choosing date, slot, party size, contact details, review and confirmation

routes.name: Manage Booking
routes.purpose: Recover a booking by durable reference, display its current status and allow cancellation when confirmed

states.empty: booking entry remains visible even if all listed dates later become sold out
states.error: not applicable on the editorial home page
states.loading: editorial content appears without a blocking remote loading state
states.success: clicking 'Book a seat' opens the booking wizard
states.validation: not applicable on the editorial home page

states.empty: when no seats remain, the wizard shows 'No seats left for the current evenings'
states.error: if saving fails, the message 'We could not save your booking. Please try again.' is visible and no reference is shown
states.loading: a visible loading or skeleton state appears while persisted bookings are read for capacity
states.success: confirmation screen shows 'Confirmed' with the durable booking reference
states.validation: date, slot, party size, name, valid email and phone are required before review

states.empty: a slot with zero remaining seats is labelled 'Sold out'
states.error: if capacity changes before confirmation, the message 'Not enough seats remain for that party size' is shown and the booking is not created
states.loading: remaining capacity is not shown as final until capacity data has loaded
states.success: available slots show remaining seat counts and can be selected
states.validation: party size cannot exceed the displayed remaining capacity

states.empty: empty required fields show field-level validation after blur or attempted continue
states.error: invalid fields keep the review step unavailable
states.loading: not applicable once the step is visible
states.success: valid fields allow the guest to continue to review
states.validation: name is required, email must look like an email, and phone is required

states.empty: if a required selection is missing the wizard returns to the first incomplete step
states.error: capacity or persistence errors keep the guest on the review step with a visible message
states.loading: not applicable once all selections are present
states.success: confirming creates the booking and shows the reference
states.validation: the review must display exact date, slot, party size and contact details before confirmation

states.empty: an unknown reference shows 'Booking not found'
states.error: if lookup fails, the message 'Unable to load booking. Try again.' is visible
states.loading: a visible loading state appears while the reference is looked up
states.success: a found booking shows its reference, status, date, slot, party size and contact details
states.validation: a malformed or empty reference shows 'Booking not found'

states.empty: not applicable for a known cancelled reference
states.error: if cancellation fails, the message 'Unable to cancel booking. Try again.' is visible and status remains 'Confirmed'
states.loading: a visible loading state appears while the cancelled booking is recovered
states.success: cancelled bookings show status 'Cancelled' after reload
states.validation: cancel control is hidden when status is already 'Cancelled'

contract.summary: A polished multi-step booking application for Ember Table where guests choose an available supper club date and slot, enter party size and validated contact details, review and confirm a durable booking, recover it after reload, and cancel it into a persistent cancelled state.

deferred.reason: the requested flow only confirms supper club seats and does not specify payment collection
no external messaging provider is available in the fixed scaffold
the requested guest journey uses durable booking references rather than authenticated accounts
public supper club dates, slot labels, opening information and editorial content are fixed in-code constants rather than backend entities
the request requires honest sold-out capacity handling, not waitlist collection
no calendar provider is included in the allowed platform capabilities

entities.name: booking
relationships: a booking references one in-code supper club date by dateId
a booking references one in-code slot by slotId
active confirmed bookings reduce the remaining capacity for their referenced slot
cancelled bookings do not count against remaining slot capacity

journeys.title: A guest completes and recovers a confirmed Ember Table booking
acceptance: a confirmed booking displays a non-empty booking reference
the confirmed booking survives a full browser reload without using localStorage-visible state

a confirmation prompt is shown explaining that the booking will be cancelled
the booking status changes to 'Cancelled' and the original booking reference remains visible
the booking reloads into an explicit 'Cancelled' state with no active confirmation controls

journeys.title: A guest cancels a confirmed booking and recovers the cancelled state
acceptance: a cancelled booking remains readable after reload
a cancelled booking shows status 'Cancelled' rather than disappearing
a cancelled booking cannot be cancelled a second time because the cancel control is not shown

journeys.title: The booking flow honestly enforces slot capacity
acceptance: party sizes above a slot's remaining capacity cannot be selected
sold-out slots are visibly labelled 'Sold out'
selecting a sold-out slot does not advance the wizard

steps.expect: name, email and phone fields are visible with a disabled continue control until valid details are entered

the message 'Name is required' is visible and the review step remains unavailable

steps.action: enter valid name, email and phone
steps.expect: validation messages disappear and the review step becomes available

journeys.title: The wizard blocks invalid contact details and displays recoverable errors
acceptance: invalid email input shows a visible validation message
blank required contact fields block progression to review
valid contact details allow the guest to proceed to the exact review step

acceptance.statement: after a guest confirms a booking, the page shows status 'Confirmed' and a non-empty durable booking reference
after a full browser reload, the confirmed booking page still shows the same booking reference, date, slot, party size and contact details
the review step displays the exact selected date, slot, party size, guest name, email and phone before the booking can be confirmed
party size options greater than the displayed remaining capacity are not selectable
a slot with zero remaining seats is visibly labelled 'Sold out' and cannot be selected
after cancellation, the booking page shows status 'Cancelled' and the same booking reference
after reloading a cancelled booking, the page still shows status 'Cancelled' and no active cancel button
entering an invalid email shows 'Enter a valid email address' and prevents progression to review
an unknown booking reference route shows 'Booking not found'

operations.description: persist a confirmed booking with a generated durable reference via db.entity('booking').create after the review step is confirmed
load a booking by its reference via db.entity('booking') so the confirmation or cancelled state can be restored after reload
read confirmed bookings for visible slots via db.entity('booking') and calculate remaining capacity from in-code slot capacities
update a booking status to 'cancelled' and set cancelledAt via db.entity('booking').update
